methods.explanation: Two numbers that differ only in sign are additive inverses: the additive inverse of \(-7\) is \(7\), and the additive inverse of \(3/4\) is \(-3/4\). \(-(-5)\) is the additive inverse of \(-5\), which equals \(5\).
